- memory_id "1000436" [decision]: On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)

- memory_id "1000291": As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is owned by Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, event bus)
- memory_id "1000283": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000271": As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000246" [preference]: As of 2025-03-19, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)

- memory_id "1000204": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000158" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000075": Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
